H3_poisoning_resistance.note: no_noise has ONE run, so a two-sample test is impossible. This Crawford-Howell test asks whether that single run lies outside the spread of noisy; it is exploratory, not confirmatory.

H3_poisoning_resistance.interpretation: positive t (no_noise mean > noisy mean) supports Ha3: noise injection -> lower poisoning degradation

rmse.reason: all 5 observations are identical (value=0.00013621); the quantity does not depend on the model under test, so no test statistic exists
rmse.why: In QGAN-LLM and Classical GAN-LLM the forecast head is a linear layer fitted in closed form on REAL rows only; the generator is never on the forecast path. H1_synthetic_data_fidelity.headline: H1 (QGAN FID lower): SUGGESTIVE_AGAINST (exploratory) -- observed QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM, p=0.024.
why: observed direction: QGAN-LLM > Classical GAN-LLM; hypothesis expects: QGAN-LLM < Classical GAN-LLM
single Classical GAN-LLM run = 103.3; QGAN-LLM mean = 131.1 (sd 5.89, n=4)
blockers: Classical GAN-LLM has only 1 run (two-sample test impossible)
QGAN-LLM runs pooled across different configs (qubits/topology/noise), so they are not repeats of one condition

H2_adversarial_resilience.headline: H2 (entanglement vs ASR): SUGGESTIVE_FOR (exploratory) -- r=-1.00, p=<0.001, n=5.
why: hypothesis expects r < 0; observed r < 0
|r| > 0.99 on so few points usually reflects configs differing in many ways at once, not a clean dose-response
blockers: only n=5 points (< 10); each point is one model config, not an independent run
H2_adversarial_resilience.next_action: Collect >= 30 independent runs spanning entanglement levels (vary seed AND entanglement setting).

H3_poisoning_resistance.headline: H3 (noise lowers poisoning degradation): INCONCLUSIVE (exploratory) -- observed no_noise < noisy, p=0.912.
why: observed direction: no_noise < noisy; hypothesis expects: no_noise > noisy
single no_noise run = 0.0003606; noisy mean = 0.000405 (sd 0.000307, n=3)
blockers: no_noise has only 1 run (two-sample test impossible)
noisy = 20-qubit ring + 12-qubit + linear-topology configs pooled; they differ from no_noise in more than the noise level only
